UPLOAD TO duke.se - built 2026-09-26, guides v1.13.0
================================================================

Copy the folders below to the web root of duke.se, keeping the paths exactly.
Do NOT upload UPLOAD.txt or urls.json - they are notes for you.

1. MUST - installed servers fetch this file, byte for byte, from a fixed address.
   It has to be online BEFORE the next server release, or every server gets a 404.

     simulationsmcp/v1/modeling_guides.json  ->  https://duke.se/simulationsmcp/v1/modeling_guides.json
     simulationsmcp/v1/guide-schema.json     ->  https://duke.se/simulationsmcp/v1/guide-schema.json

   Upload in binary mode (no line-ending conversion). Check it afterwards:
     curl -s https://duke.se/simulationsmcp/v1/modeling_guides.json | sha256sum
   must print
     a923b679a0efba85b0801d59a9c93eedf41b13faa5259f4c6343f1010d207425
   (PowerShell: Invoke-WebRequest <url> -OutFile g.json; Get-FileHash g.json)
   The server must answer with https, status 200 and no redirect to another host.

2. PAGES - one page per guide, 19 in all. Plain HTML, no styling: how they look is up to
   the web site. Folder guides/ -> https://duke.se/guides/

     /guides/
     /guides/continuous/
     /guides/continuous/feedback-control/
     /guides/flow/
     /guides/flow/tank-system/
     /guides/logistics/

     /guides/logistics/supply-chain/

     /guides/manufacturing/serial-line/
     /guides/queuing/
     /guides/queuing/multi-server/
     /guides/queuing/priority-queue/
     /guides/queuing/simple-queue/
     /guides/resources/
     /guides/resources/shared-resources/
     /guides/resources/shift-schedule/

   Once a page is online, keep its address: installed servers and other people link to it.
